prior_digest_used.use: Avoided duplicating R948 score-pitch/bank mapping and R950 typed local-object alignment/lifetime review; did not read their report bodies.

scope_depth_novelty.assessment: A coherent comparison of the SyclKittens tile/data-movement methods, a prior Intel XeTLA design, and BMG-capable SYCL-TLA/vLLM references, bounded to applicability for B570-oriented attention/gather and expert GEMM questions. The report covers hardware assumptions, alternatives, counterevidence, provenance, and retrieval points; it makes no implementation recommendation.
scope_depth_novelty.novelty: Distinct from R948's score-layout/pitch question and R950's typed local_accessor object, member-offset, and alignment contract. R952 adds a PVC cache-prefetch/dataflow study and a separately pinned BMG-capable SYCL-TLA/vLLM path; it does not repeat prior local-layout findings.
scope_depth_novelty.depth: Substantive at 1,550 words. It compares direct L1-prefetch/register loads against SLM staging and synchronized pipelines, separates tile methods from tile policies, examines selected-K and routed-expert counterevidence, and bounds published split-K evidence to its actual measured shapes.
scope_depth_novelty.provenance: The report is a design-literature summary. No source code, helper, test, or diagnostic is copied or adapted. SyclKittens' root MIT license and third-party notice are checked; the report correctly notes that paper references to HipKittens are not resolved by the notice and says future source reuse needs file-level origin/license review. XeStrata was not accessed or used.

source_and_citation_review.verified: Pinned README identifies oneAPI DPC++/SYCL 2020/C++20 and Intel Data Center GPU Max (PVC) as the supplied AOT target; Python extensions need XPU PyTorch/pybind11, GEMV fallback needs oneMKL, and distributed targets need Level Zero headers. Root license is MIT. The notice identifies ThunderKittens under MIT and SYCLomatic/LLVM under Apache-2.0 with LLVM exceptions; it has no HipKittens match. The pinned commit and cited kernel-file pages resolve to the requested revision.
source_and_citation_review.limit: The retrieved commit page identifies the exact commit and sign-off but did not expose a GitHub Verified signature status. The report's valid-signature statement is therefore not independently confirmed here; the immutable commit hash remains a valid source pin.

source_and_citation_review.verified: The paper identifies Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550 (PVC) as the measured target. It supports the SIMD16/XMX and 32-BF16-element/64-byte row account; 16x16→32x32 cumulative GEMM result 37.4%→68.2%; de-duplicated prefetch result 91.0%→96.2%; cache-prefetch semantics; the stated SLM read and IGC-address-space costs; online softmax; and the split-K table at M=N=512, K=2048–32768, including the 0.96x result at K=32768. These are paper-reported PVC results, not local measurements.
source_and_citation_review.scope_correction: Appendix E single-GPU MHA/GQA measurements use D=128 and N up to 8192. Other paper sections separately report context-parallel attention through 98,304 total tokens across six GPU packages and end-to-end TP×CP decode at 256K across twelve GPUs. Those multi-GPU results do not qualify the single-GPU B570 path or random selected-K gather.
source_and_citation_review.license: The arXiv page identifies its perpetual non-exclusive license; arXiv's license guidance describes this as limited distribution permission for the article. It is not a software-source license.

source_and_citation_review.verified: The landing page describes XeTLA v0.3.7 and GEMM selection by data/layout/space/alignment/tile/engine/stages/synchronization; the displayed default XMX source has configurable memory descriptors, cache prefetch, synchronization plumbing, and slm_size=0.
source_and_citation_review.caveat: These documentation pages are live rather than pinned and are inconsistent: the source-page header says v0.3.6 while the landing-page body says v0.3.7. Keep the report's source-level observation as a documentation snapshot, and require a tag/commit before relying on it for future source comparison.

source_and_citation_review.source: Intel SYCL-TLA and vLLM XPU CMake
source_and_citation_review.verified: The pinned README lists Intel Arc B580/Xe2, intel_gpu_bmg_g21, oneAPI 2025.1+ and BSD-3-Clause. The pinned vLLM CMake fetches https://github.com/intel/sycl-tla.git at that revision, defaults BUILD_SYCL_TLA_KERNELS on, builds Xe2 grouped GEMM/attention families, and selects intel_gpu_bmg_g21 on the non-Xe3p branch.
source_and_citation_review.limit: This establishes a separate BMG-capable software reference. Its listed hardware is B580; it does not prove support, performance, or compiler behavior on B570 or in Strata.

corrections.detail: The report's N≤8192 statement is accurate for the single-GPU Appendix E full-sequence MHA/GQA kernel, but the phrase 'attention evidence' could be read as excluding all long-context evidence in the paper. Distinguish Appendix E from the separate multi-GPU context-parallel and 256K end-to-end results. Neither is evidence for B570 single-GPU execution or the project's random selected-K path.

XeTLA landing page labels v0.3.7, while the cited generated default-XMX source page labels v0.3.6. The inspected API and slm_size=0 code are visible, but the published URL is mutable and version-inconsistent; require an immutable tag or commit if exact source behavior matters.

GitHub's retrieved commit page exposed the commit identity and Signed-off-by line but no Verified signature marker. The report's valid-signature claim was not independently confirmed in this review; this does not invalidate the immutable SHA provenance pin.

retrieval.retrieve_when: A Main-owned B570 source/codegen and component profile leaves a concrete unresolved choice involving cache prefetch versus SLM/register staging, tile ownership, online-softmax dataflow, random selected-K locality, or small-M/long-K grouped GEMM.
retrieval_keys: SyclKittens cache prefetch warms L1 and is separate from the demand register load; its PVC mechanism is architecture-specific.
The paper's no-SLM and address-space-cost evidence is measured on PVC; do not infer a B570 bank, spill, or ISA cause from it.
Split-K is described for small-M/N and large-K targets but its reported sweep uses dense M=N=512 BF16 GEMMs on PVC, not routed per-expert token distributions.
SYCL-TLA/vLLM provides a separately licensed BMG reference pinned to a commit and a B580 target; confirm actual B570 support and local lowering independently.
